title: The category standard, three ways
question: You chose the familiar path with soft corners, high legibility and no terminal-mono type. Benchmarked against chanhdai.com and nemaas.com. Pick the one to build.

options.label: Ruled Column
options.thesis: One calm centred column between hairline rails; dither lives in the gutters and in your portrait, so content stays crisp and the art frames it.
options.viewport: Rounded dithered portrait that resolves to the photo on hover, big name, two-line intro, Download CV + See my work, and the first project row starting under a rule.
options.risk: The most restrained; it relies on typography and spacing craft to not feel like a template.

options.label: Living Scene
options.lineage: nemaas.com's canvas scene, dithered cell by cell
options.thesis: A dithered canvas of Galeras over Pasto with a road and a car you can poke, which flips between day and night with the theme; your profile card sits below it.
materials: rounded profile card overlapping the scene
options.viewport: Top 60%: the interactive dither scene (volcano, road, a passing car). Below: a rounded card with your dithered avatar, name, intro and Download CV.
options.risk: Closest to nemaas in structure; the scene must feel personal (Pasto, cars) and stay calm, or it becomes the noisy background you said no to.

options.label: Soft Bento
options.thesis: Your first screen as a grid of soft tiles: intro, dithered portrait, MAGI, Ghost Layer, stack, and a dither art tile of cars.
options.viewport: Intro tile with Download CV, tall dithered portrait tile, MAGI tile, a cars dither tile, small fact tiles.
options.risk: The most common portfolio layout right now; easy to scan, hardest to remember.
